modality: knee MRI (Osteoarthritis Initiative) with segmentation masks
role: candidate source of ARTICULAR CARTILAGE geometry, of which this body has none (51 cartilage entities, none articular -- docs/TISSUE_MECHANICS.md)
access: HuggingFace, not gated; declared licence cc-by-nc-4.0; citing the CartiMorph paper (doi:10.1016/j.media.2023.103035) and the OAIZIB paper is compulsory per the card

verified_here.also: CLAIR-Knee-103R template atlas with a 20-ROI articular cartilage atlas
verified_here.not_present: patellar cartilage; any joint but the knee
verified_here.licence_file: info/license: 'Data and code are released under CC-BY-NC 4.0'
verified_here.layout: one integer-labelled NIfTI per knee, 160x384x384 at 0.7x0.365x0.365 mm, RAS; femur cut at the top of the volume, tibia at the bottom, cartilage whole
verified_here.knee_side: all 507 are RIGHT knees (info/kneeSideInfo.csv, no header row; KneeSide = 1 in both spreadsheets) -- the known answer for the which-knee gate

gender_coding.established_from_anatomy: code 1: 262 knees, tibial-plateau width 82.2 +/- 4.5 mm, cartilage 22.3 +/- 3.8 mL; code 2: 245 knees, 72.4 +/- 3.5 mm, 16.6 +/- 2.4 mL. code 1 is 13.5% wider and carries 33.9% more cartilage; both measures agree, ~2.4 SD apart on width. matches the OAI convention (1 = male), which was recalled and NOT relied on

verified_here.note: case 454's image was flagged corrupted and replaced upstream (15 Feb 2025); the labels are used here, not the images

basis_for_use: the programme owner confirmed on 2026-09-10 that this programme is non-commercial scientific research (recorded for UT-EndoMRI); CC-BY-NC-4.0's condition is non-commercial use
not_verified_here: the licence of the upstream OAIZIB release (Ambellan et al.) and whether cc-by-nc-4.0 is consistent with it
the Osteoarthritis Initiative's own data-use terms for its MRI
plan: labels only (femur, tibia for bone-to-bone registration onto this body's knee; cartilage for geometry); the images are not needed

acquisition.sha256_verified_against: the HuggingFace LFS sha256 for each file
acquisition.images_not_taken: the 12 GB of images are not needed: labels carry the bones for registration and the cartilage

selection_rule: KL grade 0 only (no radiographic osteoarthritis), fixed before any registration: male (code 1) knees for this body, female (code 2) knees for a female variant
